about: Seed questions. 'aa' are the five questions AA-PersonalityBench publishes on its methodology page, plus the question its judging demo shows; they are public, so they go into the tuning split only. The rest are mine, written natively per language. Seeds show the drafting model the style; every seed goes to the tuning split, never to the held-out split.
